stack: Static single-page app in plain JavaScript (ES modules) and HTML page fragments, built by build.mjs with esbuild into committed index.html, app.js, styles.css, cloud.js and words.json; word data in data/*.txt; Firebase (Google sign-in, Firestore, Firebase AI Logic with Gemini, optional App Check); Google Apps Script for the weekly e-mail and the Power BI export; node:test for checks; GitHub Pages from the main branch

requirements.title: Admin turns features on and off on a Features tab
ac: Given I am signed in as an admin, When I open Admin → Features, Then after a fresh read of the flags I see AI and My lists, Learner prompts and Report a mistake, each with a short description and an on/off switch showing its current state; if the read fails I see an error and no switches

Given I am on the Features tab, When I switch a toggle, Then only that flag is saved to Firestore (the flags field of meta/info), I see a confirmation, the other flags keep their stored values, and the toggle keeps its new state after I reload the page
Given the save fails, When I switch a toggle, Then I see an error message and the toggle returns to its previous state

Given an admin switched a feature off, When a learner loads the site afterwards, Then once the flags have loaded the learner sees the new state, without any deploy or rebuild (a learner who visited before may see the previous state for a moment while the flags load)

requirements.title: AI and My lists can be switched off (one switch)
ac: Given AI and My lists is off, When a learner (signed in or not) views the site, Then the My lists menu link, the "My word lists" button in the Account card, the word-lists line in the sign-in invite and the word-lists mention in the signed-out Account card are hidden

Given AI and My lists is off, When a learner opens #lists directly, Then they see only a short "This feature is not available right now" message, without the page's AI intro, and no AI request is sent
Given AI and My lists is off, When a learner opens a word card or a flashcard, Then the AI-written "In plain words" and "Story" boxes are not shown (stored text is hidden too, ADR-008)

Given AI and My lists is off, When an admin uses the site, Then the admin still sees the My lists link and page, the AI extraction and the plain-words and story boxes, and Admin → AI tools still works

requirements.title: Learner prompts can be switched off
ac: Given Learner prompts is off, When a new visitor loads the site, Then the role picker, the level picker and the sign-in invite do not open by themselves

Given Learner prompts is off, When a visitor picks a role or level by hand (the role and level cards on Home, a link with ?role=, or the Browse filters), Then the choice works as it does today, and no level picker opens by itself afterwards

requirements.title: Report a mistake can be switched off
ac: Given Report a mistake is off, When a learner opens a word or Workplace English card, Then the "Report a wrong meaning or example" / "Report a problem" link is hidden, the sign-in invite and the signed-out Account card do not mention reporting, and the 👎 feedback message does not point to the report link
Given Report a mistake is off, When an admin opens a card, Then the report link and the admin Edit link are still shown

requirements.title: Every feature stays on when the flags cannot be loaded
ac: Given Firebase is not set up, or meta/info is missing, has no flags or cannot be read, When anyone loads the site, Then every feature is on, as it is today, even if this browser cached an earlier "off"
Given meta/info.flags has a flag name the site does not know, or is missing a known flag, When the site loads, Then unknown names are ignored and missing flags count as on

Given the Firebase script fails to load, When 6 seconds have passed and the page has finished loading, Then every feature is on; Given the Firebase script or the flags read is slow, When 6 seconds pass, Then the site keeps waiting for it and does not switch features on in between

tests.title: Flags resolve to all on when the value is missing, unreadable or partial (unknown names ignored); with no read at all the cached copy is dropped by the fallback; a read that has started is waited for, even when slow; code waiting for the flags (the prompts) runs only once they are known
An off flag hides the feature for learners but not for admins

Admin switches each flag on the Features tab: only that flag changes in meta/info.flags, the state survives a reload and a learner sees it on next load; a failed save reverts the toggle; a failed read shows an error and no switches; Sync built-in words keeps the flags; on a project never synced, saving a flag creates meta/info with only flags, the site keeps its built-in words, and the next Sync keeps the flag

As a learner, with each flag off in turn: (AI and My lists) the My lists menu link, the Account card button and texts and the invite line are hidden, #lists shows only the not-available message, no request goes to the AI (DevTools → Network shows no firebasevertexai / generativelanguage call), and the plain-words and story boxes are hidden on word cards and flashcards; (prompts) on a fresh browser profile, also with DevTools network throttling set to Slow 3G, no role picker, level picker or sign-in invite opens; picking a role from My profile does not open the level picker by itself; while the Home role and level cards, a ?role= link and the Browse filters still work; (report) the report links are hidden on word and Workplace English cards, the invite and Account card do not mention reporting, and the 👎 message does not point to the report link

As an admin, with every flag off: the My lists link and page work, the AI extraction block and the plain-words and story boxes show, Admin → AI tools runs, and the report and Edit links show on word and Workplace English cards; after signing out, the same browser shows the learner view

decisions.title: Static site on GitHub Pages with the build output committed to main
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: build.mjs generates index.html, app.js, styles.css, cloud.js and words.json from src/ and data/, and those files are committed. GitHub Pages serves the main branch as it is, with no deploy workflow.
decisions.consequences: Every change to src/ or data/ must be rebuilt (npm run build) and the generated files committed in the same PR; Compass CI fails when they are stale. The Compass deploy workflow (compass-deploy.yml) is not installed.

decisions.title: Firebase on the free plan: Google sign-in and Firestore, content read as packed bundles
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: Learner accounts, progress, lists, reports and the word content live in Firestore. The site reads words as packed bundles of 150 words (bundles/words-01…), so a visit costs about 20 reads. Access is controlled by firestore.rules; admins are listed in admins/{uid}.
decisions.consequences: Changes to firestore.rules change who can read and write data, so the file is a protected path. Built-in words reach Firestore only when an admin runs Admin → Content & sync → Sync.

decisions.title: AI features run in the browser through Firebase AI Logic (Gemini) on the free tier
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: Translations, plain explanations, stories and My lists extraction call Gemini through Firebase AI Logic, trying several flash models in turn (src/cloud.js TEXT_MODELS), with long timeouts for slow free-tier replies. App Check protects the AI quota when a site key is set in src/firebase-config.js.
decisions.consequences: No server or API key to manage. AI output must be checked by a person; learners report mistakes and admins fix them.

decisions.title: Word ids stay stable: new word files are added at the end
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: Word ids are assigned in the order of the data/ files, so new files are added at the end (e.g. 10-…txt) and existing lines are not reordered.
decisions.consequences: Progress, lists and reports refer to word ids; reordering data files would point them at the wrong words.

decisions.title: Insights and visit counts store no names or e-mails
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: Admin → Insights counts signed-in learners only and stores no names or e-mails; visits/{date} holds anonymous daily counts; the Power BI export shows learners only as an anonymous code.
decisions.consequences: Personal data stays out of analytics; any new metric must keep to this rule.

decisions.title: The public Firebase web API key is allowed by the secret scan
decisions.context: Decided before Compass was adopted; recorded when the project was onboarded to the Compass Framework (2026-11-27). Back-filled from the README and git history; confirmed by the Product Owner on 2026-11-27.
decisions.decision: compass/guardrails.json keeps the Google API key pattern (AIza…) but exempts this project's own Firebase web API key, which is public by design (src/firebase-config.js) and bundled into cloud.js on one long line.
decisions.consequences: Without the exemption, every rebuild of cloud.js would fail the guardrails check. Any other Google API key is still blocked.

decisions.title: GitHub Pages serves the site without Jekyll
decisions.context: The site is prebuilt by build.mjs (ADR-001), but GitHub Pages still ran Jekyll on the main branch. Jekyll renders Markdown files without front matter, so Liquid tags (double curly braces, or a brace followed by a percent sign) in any compass/*.md would fail the Pages build and stop the live site from updating. Raised in the independent review of #2; the Product Owner asked for the fix.
decisions.decision: An empty .nojekyll at the repository root turns Jekyll off; Pages serves the committed files as they are.
decisions.consequences: Markdown files are no longer turned into HTML pages on the site (none are linked from it). Files and folders starting with _ or . (such as .github/, .claude/settings.json and .gitignore) are served too; none holds a secret, and the repo is public.

decisions.title: Turning AI off also hides stored AI-written text
decisions.context: Review of huynhthu1704/learn-it-vocab#14 noted that the "In plain words" and "Story" boxes show text that admins generated earlier and stored with each word, so hiding them saves no AI quota.
decisions.decision: The Product Owner decided on 2026-11-28 to keep them hidden: when AI features is off, learners see neither live AI calls (My lists extraction) nor stored AI-written text.
decisions.consequences: Turning AI off changes what learners read on word cards, not just what calls the AI. Admins still see the boxes.

decisions.title: My lists and AI features are one switch
decisions.context: Review of huynhthu1704/learn-it-vocab#15: with AI features off but My lists on, learners could see their lists but not create new ones, and the page still promised AI extraction.
decisions.decision: The Product Owner decided on 2026-11-28 to merge the two into one switch, "AI and My lists" (flag `ai`). REQ-003 is merged into REQ-002 and removed.
decisions.consequences: Three switches: AI and My lists, Learner prompts, Report a mistake. Turning AI off also hides My lists.

decisions.title: Feature flags live in meta/info, at no extra read per visit
decisions.context: A separate meta/flags document would add one read per visit (about 5% more on the free plan, 50,000 reads a day, about 20 reads per visit).
decisions.decision: The Product Owner decided on 2026-11-28 to store the flags in the `flags` field of meta/info, which every visit already reads. The Features tab reads meta/info fresh and saves one flag at a time with a merge.
decisions.consequences: Learners pay no extra reads; an admin pays one read each time they open Admin or Features, and one write per switch. Every writer of meta/info keeps the flags: writeBundlesAndMeta (Sync, Rebuild) merges, saveItems updates named fields only, saveFlags merges into the nested map. Saving a flag before the first Sync creates meta/info with only flags, which the site treats as nothing published yet.
